values.note: The website's reservation form takes a deposit and is confirmed by the office during office hours (Mon-Fri 8-5:30, Sat 12:30-5:30); stays of seven nights or more by phone, 912-681-3105. Refund if cancelled 48 hours ahead (7 days on event dates, 2 weeks for 7+ night stays); no refunds for early departure.

note: Big-rig RV park on US-301 south of Statesboro: open level sites, paved roads, pool, clubhouse, propane; cottages and RV storage. --Claude
summary: Own site (no priced engine - a deposit request form): $47 a night, +$5 on special-event dates, 7th night free, monthly $680 + electric (stored 47 confirmed; no year on the page). Site map (2025): 47 RV sites, 41 pull-throughs + 6 back-ins, all full hookups 50/30/20 A. Count 50 -> 47, hookups/laundry confirmed, showers/toilets, booking url and note added. Gate: $47 < US$50 (no gateway within 40 km; Savannah 76 km). Presence: working website with rates, phone (912) 681-3105 (matches), office hours. Note cleaned (counts, hookups, booking line dropped).
flags: Price gate: $47 passes, but special-event dates add $5 ('For Special Events: +$5') = $52 on those dates, over US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Savannah 76 km). Event dates are on the park's Google calendar.

Long-stay tests: nightly ($47), weekly and monthly ($680 + electric) rates are all posted and short stays book through the website form (test 2 passes); the site pitches it as 'a great option for your winter home' and has monthly cottages. No published count of sites held by monthly guests, so test 4 (share sold nightly) can't be checked from the operator; no reviews read.
